---

```{julia}
#| echo: false
#| output: false
using Pkg
Pkg.activate(joinpath(@__DIR__, ".."))
using AIHydroPoints
using DataFrames
using PrettyTables

function show_leaderboard(root_dir, quantities; sort_by="rmse_testing", ascending=true)
    lb = load_leaderboard(root_dir; quantities=quantities)

    if isempty(lb)
        @warn "No runs found for $(quantities) in $(root_dir)."
        return
    end

    lb = sort_leaderboard(lb, sort_by; ascending=ascending)
    lb[!, :rank] = 1:nrow(lb)
    select!(lb, :rank, :)

    display_cols = [:rank, :runid, :model_name, :out_quantities, :rmse_testing,
                    :n_params, :train_time_s]
    available = [c for c in display_cols if c in propertynames(lb)]
    pretty_table(lb[!, available]; backend=:html, stand_alone=false, column_labels=string.(available))
end
```

## 5 Stations

### Surge Leaderboard

```{julia}
#| echo: false
show_leaderboard(joinpath(@__DIR__, "5stations", "training_output"), ["surge"])
```
